notes: Supplier credit transactions (manual invoices/settlements, VN_TRNSTYPE EFFECT 1). Screen corrected: invoice lines with INV_VALUE/VAT (legacy line-level GET_TAX_VALUE), VN_SUBSUBTRNS/VN_SUBTRNS_COST grids dropped (children of VN_SUBTRNS, unused). Wave 3b: legacy LOVs (credit types, suppliers, payment types of the supplier as a cascading list, cost centres, accounts), type fixed after insert, stop-payment check box on the invoice lines.

rules.where: TRNS_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM VN_TRNSTYPE WHERE EFFECT = 1 AND TRNS_TYPE <> 5 AND NVL(SUM_TRNS, 0) = 0) AND NVL(LINK_FLAG, 0) = 0 AND SERIAL IS NULL AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR TRNS_ID IN (SELECT TRNS_ID FROM VN_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD WHERE FLAG = 1 AND PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR (SUPPLIER_ID >= (SELECT FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) AND SUPPLIER_ID <= (SELECT TO_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

after_save.name: VNCRTRN invoice lines, totals, GL link

VN_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ID.lov: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from vn_trnstype where effect = 1 and trns_type <> 5 and nvl(sum_trns, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from vn_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by id

VN_MAINTRNS.SUPPLIER_ID.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS.PAY_TYPE_CODE.lov: select lc.settel_type_code || ' - ' || lc.settel_type_desc d, lc.settel_type_code r from lc_settel_type lc, vn_pay_methode_acc ac where lc.settel_type_code = ac.settel_type_code and ac.supplier_code = :PAGE_SUPPLIER_ID order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS.COST_NO.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost1 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS.COST_NO2.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or cost_code in (select p.cost_code from ac_password_cost2 p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by 2

VN_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

VN_MAINTRNS_ACC.ACC_NUMBER.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number
